title: 第1386章 破境第1385章 强势镇压
slug: 无敌凡体以剑证道杀穿三千界
lines: 神秘空间之中。
李轩并不知道外面发生的事情，更是不知道老对头翁潜仙王才刚刚高调现身，便被一墓碑屈辱的砸入了地底。
此刻，他已经彻底杀疯了，那些冲进来的修士被他斩了个七七八八，只剩下了最后六人。
至于他自己，同样也是浑身浴血，遍体鳞伤，气息萎靡，惨不忍睹。
原本灰蒙蒙的空间早已变成血色，那些乱石坟堆也被鲜血染红，地上血流成河，尸骨成堆，浓郁的血腥味更是怎么都无法散去。
这里好似彻底变成了人间炼狱，真的很难想象先前究竟经历过怎样的厮杀和战斗。
“来，来啊，你们这些垃圾，不是要杀老子吗，怎么不动手了，再来啊！”李轩拄剑而立，脚步趔趄，仿佛风一吹便会倒。
只不过，他的气势却是很足，依旧还在疯狂挑衅着对面那最后六人。
他现在只有一个感觉，那就是累，真的累，身心疲惫，浑身无力。
简啸六人看着那浑身浴血，宛若杀神一般的李轩，则是都有些胆寒。
在他们眼里，李轩仿佛早已经不再是人，而是一个怪物。
因为这短短的时间，他们见证了什么才是打不死的小强，什么才叫做生命力强盛！
李轩就犹如是一具杀戮傀儡，皮糙肉厚不说，体内仙元也仿佛是无穷无尽。
他大招一次又一次的爆发，伤势也是一次又一次的迅速痊愈，实在是变态的有些过分。
此刻，他们看着李轩，那是真的胆寒，因为死的人实在太多了，这种杀戮，哪怕他们这种久经沙场的老将，都是有些难以承受。
“简啸，你不是追杀了老子一路吗，你不是想杀老子领功吗？怎么现在却缩在了后面？来，你过来，看老子能不能一剑斩了你。”
李轩目光转动，最终落在了简啸身上，语气森寒。
他心里也很是诧异，自己先前都杀成那样了，这家伙却还没死，有点道行啊。
简啸听到李轩的挑衅，脸色则是无比的难看。
他一声不吭。
过去？
开玩笑，送死吗？
要知道，李轩杀的那些人中，可有不少比他强大。
若非他比较机灵，且保命手段颇多，恐怕也早死了。
“孬种！”
李轩看到简啸不敢动，再次不屑的哼了一声，又看向了其余五人。
那五人看到李轩目光扫来，也都是纷纷低头，没有人敢与李轩对视。
李轩看到这一幕，面上不屑更甚，心中却是松了口气。
他不敢浪费时间，而是疯狂的炼化那些尸体和资源，冲击起了至仙境二重境界。
没有人知道，他现在真的已经到了强弩之末，若简啸六人敢继续拼死一搏，他哪怕不死，也必定会很惨。
他唯一有些欣慰的是，经过此次大战，他不仅肉身再次变强了许多，而且修为也有了松动，感受到了至仙境二重的壁障。
content_en:
In the mysterious space.
Li Xuan didn't know what was happening outside, and he didn't even know that his old enemy, Immortal King Weng Qian, had just made a high-profile appearance and was humiliatingly smashed into the ground by a tombstone.
At this moment, he had gone completely crazy and killed all the monks who rushed in, leaving only the last six.
As for himself, he was also covered in blood, bruised, breathless, and miserable.
The originally gray space had already turned into blood, and the stone tombs were dyed red with blood. Rivers of blood flowed on the ground, corpses piled up in piles, and the strong smell of blood could not be dissipated no matter what.
This place seems to have completely turned into a purgatory on earth. It is really hard to imagine what kind of killings and battles they have experienced before.
"Come on, come on, you trash, don't you want to kill me? Why don't you do it? Come again!" Li Xuan stood with his sword, his steps staggering, as if he would fall down if the wind blew.
However, his momentum was very strong, and he was still madly provoking the last six people on the opposite side.
He only feels one thing now, that is, tired, really tired, physically and mentally exhausted, and completely weak.
Jian Xiao and the others were a little frightened when they looked at Li Xuan, who was covered in blood and looked like a murderous god.
In their eyes, Li Xuan seemed to be no longer a human being, but a monster.
Because in this short period of time, they witnessed what it means to be an invincible Xiaoqiang and what it means to have strong vitality!
Li Xuan was like a killing puppet. Not only was he thick-skinned, but he also seemed to have endless immortal energy in his body.
His ultimate attack exploded again and again, and his injuries healed quickly again and again. It was really too abnormal.
At this moment, they looked at Li Xuan with real fear, because too many people had died. This kind of killing was a bit unbearable even for veterans like them who had been on the battlefield for a long time.
"Jian Xiao, didn't you chase me all the way? Didn't you want to kill me to get the merit? Why are you shrinking back now? Come on, come over and see if I can kill you with one sword."
Li Xuan's eyes turned and finally fell on Jian Xiao, his tone was cold.
He was also very surprised in his heart. He had been killed like that before, but this guy was not dead yet. He was quite virtuous.
When Jian Xiao heard Li Xuan's provocation, his expression turned extremely ugly.
He said nothing.
past?
Are you kidding me? Are you going to die?
You know, many of the people Li Xuan killed were stronger than him.
If he hadn't been more clever and had many ways to save his life, he might have died long ago.
"Coward!"
Seeing that Jian Xiao didn't dare to move, Li Xuan snorted disdainfully again and looked at the other five people.
When the five people saw Li Xuan's glance, they all lowered their heads. No one dared to look at Li Xuan.
When Li Xuan saw this scene, his disdain on his face became even greater, but he was relieved in his heart.
He did not dare to waste time, but frantically refined the corpses and resources, and reached the second level of the Immortal Realm.
No one knows that he has really reached the end of his strength now. If Jian Xiao and the others dare to continue fighting to the death, even if he does not die, he will definitely be miserable.
The only thing he was somewhat gratified about was that after this battle, not only had his body become much stronger again, but his cultivation had also loosened, and he could feel the second level barrier of the Immortal Realm.
